title: Garmin inReach Message Distance From Home Leaderboard
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=inreach:message distance_from_home_km=*
| stats sum(distance_from_home_km) as total_value, avg(distance_from_home_km) as avg_value by contact_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks contact name values by total and average distance from home across Garmin inReach message events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `distance_from_home_km` values for each Garmin inReach message event and review total and average distance from home by contact name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total distance from home.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which contact name shows the biggest distance from home numbers in your Garmin inReach message data.
